note: The provider DECLINING rather than disagreeing. Asked to prepare a claim for a wallet the distributor owes nothing, the endpoint answers HTTP 400 with a bare `error` sentence and no `details[]` - the same shape the launch endpoints use. It maps to POOLS_INVALID_REQUEST, which `crossCheckPoolsHolderRewardsPrepare` reads as `declined`: the provider had no calldata to give, which is NOT a disagreement about bytes and never refuses a claim on its own. Whether there is anything to claim is decided by the on-chain simulation. The request body carried the Vex probe wallet and is not recorded here; the response contains no address at all and is verbatim.
